faq.title: Dutchie Pro Migration & Development FAQ

items.q: Can you upgrade our existing Dutchie embedded menu to E-Commerce Pro?
items.a: Yes. We help dispensaries transition from embedded Dutchie menus to E-Commerce Pro, including storefront setup, website integration, redirects, and SEO validation. We've completed implementations for Verdi Cannabis and Mighty Lucky in New York.

items.q: Do we need to rebuild our existing website?
items.a: Usually not. We can integrate Dutchie Pro with your existing Shopify or WordPress website using Cloudflare reverse proxy technology, keeping your main website, content, and branding in place.

items.q: Can you customize an existing Dutchie Pro storefront?
items.a: Yes. With direct access to the Dutchie Pro SDK, we can develop custom headers, footers, navigation, product cards, category layouts, filters, and branded components within the platform's supported capabilities.

items.q: Will migrating to Dutchie Pro affect our Google rankings?
items.a: Any website migration carries SEO risks. We review existing URLs, implement strategic redirects, verify canonical tags and XML sitemaps, and monitor indexing after launch to minimize disruption. Rankings cannot be guaranteed.

items.q: How long does a Dutchie Pro migration take?
items.a: Timelines depend on your current setup, the number of locations, custom development requirements, and Dutchie onboarding. We review your website and provide a project-specific timeline before starting.

items.q: How much does Dutchie Pro migration or custom development cost?
items.a: Pricing depends on your existing platform, integration requirements, number of locations, and level of customization. After reviewing your current setup, we provide a clear scope and project estimate. Dutchie's own platform fees are separate.

items.q: Can you handle multiple dispensary locations?
items.a: Yes. We can plan multi-location Dutchie Pro implementations, including location-specific storefronts, website integration, navigation, SEO redirects, and Google indexing checks.

items.q: Do we need to change our POS or leave Dutchie?
items.a: No platform change is required if you're already using compatible Dutchie services. We focus on the e-commerce storefront and its integration with your website. Any account-specific requirements should be confirmed with Dutchie.
